items.title: Register with the Allegheny County local tax collector for earned income tax and local services tax
items.authority: Local tax collector for the worksite's tax collection district
items.description: Employers register with the collector shown on the DCED address search (it gives the PSD code, earned income tax rate and local services tax rate for each worksite) to get a local tax ID, and keep a residency certification form for each employee. Register for every Pennsylvania worksite, including remote employees' home offices.

items.title: Remit local earned income tax and local services tax for Allegheny County worksites
items.authority: Local tax collector for the worksite's tax collection district
items.description: Withhold the local earned income tax (and the local services tax where levied) and file and pay quarterly within 30 days after each calendar quarter ends, usually on the collector's website. Employers that combine worksites with one collector file monthly; the combined option does not apply to the local services tax. Rates differ by municipality and school district.

items.title: File the W-2R earned income tax reconciliation for Allegheny County
items.authority: Local tax collector for the worksite's tax collection district
items.description: File the W-2R annual reconciliation of earned income tax withheld with each local tax collector by the last day of February after the calendar year.

items.title: Collect and remit Allegheny County local sales and use tax
items.authority: Pennsylvania Department of Revenue
items.description: Vendors already required to collect Pennsylvania sales tax must collect and remit Allegheny County's 1% local sales and use tax on taxable sales and uses in the county with the state return; apply the current sourcing and exemption rules.
items.deadline: On the assigned Pennsylvania sales and use tax filing schedule

note: Pennsylvania has no general business personal property tax. Allegheny County levies a 7% hotel room rental tax through the Treasurer's Special Tax Division (Hotel Tax Account Application), but only secondary sources were found for its return due date.

items.title: File the Berks County hotel room rental tax return

items.title: File and deposit the Philadelphia Wage Tax
items.authority: Philadelphia Department of Revenue
items.description: How often depends on the Wage Tax withheld each month: under $350 file quarterly (2026 dates: April 30, July 31, October 31 and February 1, 2027); $350 to under $16,000 monthly, about two to three weeks after the month ends; $16,000 or more semi-monthly or weekly. The city publishes each year's schedule. The employer withholding rate was not confirmed.
